ai_summary.text:
技研製作所は圧入工法と杭打ち機の製造を手がけるメーカーで、サイレントパイラーと呼ばれる無振動・無騒音の杭圧入引抜機を主力としている。従来の打撃工法に対して振動と騒音を大幅に抑制する圧入工法のパイオニアとして、都市部の建設現場や河川護岸工事で独自のポジションを確立。インプラント工法による地中構造物の構築技術も保有する。

売上263億円（前年比-10.7%）と減収。営業利益26億円（営業利益率9.7%）と安定した利益率を維持し、純利益15億円。圧入工事の大型案件の端境期が減収の主因だが利益率は堅調に推移した。ROE3.7%と控えめな資本効率にとどまっている。

自己資本比率84.2%と極めて高い水準にあり、財務健全性スコア83点と健全な財務基盤。営業CF14億円、FCF2億円と黒字を維持。EPS56円に対しPER26.1倍と市場からの高い評価、配当54円で配当性向は約97%と極めて手厚い株主還元。防災インフラの強靭化と都市部の低騒音工事需要が中長期の事業を支えている。
ai_summary.text_en: Giken Seisaku-sho manufactures pile-pressing equipment and pile-driving machines, with the Silent Piler a vibration-free and silent pile press-in extraction machine as its flagship product. As a pioneer in press-in methods that significantly reduce vibration and noise compared to conventional impact methods, the company has established unique market positioning in urban construction sites and riverbank reinforcement projects. The company also holds technology for underground structure construction using implant methods.  Revenue was 26.3 billion yen (-10.7% YoY) showing decline. Operating profit of 2.6 billion yen (9.7% margin) maintains stable profitability, with net profit of 1.5 billion yen. The decline stems primarily from a gap period in major press-in projects, though profit margins remained solid. ROE of 3.7% represents modest capital efficiency.  Equity ratio of 84.2% is extremely high, and financial health score of 83 points indicates sound financial foundation. Operating cash flow of 1.4 billion yen and free cash flow of 0.2 billion yen maintain profitability. At 56 yen EPS with PER of 26.1x, high market valuation reflects recovery expectations; dividend of 54 yen yields payout ratio of approximately 97%, providing very generous shareholder returns. Disaster prevention infrastructure strengthening and low-noise construction demand in urban areas support medium-to-long-term business.
